corpus.processing: released mixture (the card's weighting recipe is not applied)

model.architecture: decoder-only, SwiGLU, mlp_ratio 8, RoPE, RMSNorm with affine eps 1e-6, no biases, untied embeddings, init normal std 0.02 truncated at 3 std

eval.metric: c4_en_bits_per_token: mean next-token cross-entropy on held-out C4-en validation, in nats divided by ln 2, at the final checkpoint
eval.data: the OLMo in-loop evaluator file eval-data/perplexity/v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val/part-0-00000.npy (public at olmo-data.org; sha256 c37d6b11...), decoded or re-tokenized with the ladder tokenizer; if Paloma's c4_en validation split is confirmed identical, either may be used
eval.unverified: whether the in-loop file equals Paloma's c4_en validation split document for document (it is drawn from C4-en validation; see in_loop_file_check)
eval.decontamination: documents in any training corpus exactly matching a Paloma c4_en validation or test document are removed before training

in_loop_file_check.result: all 2,099 documents of DataDecide's in-loop c4_en-validation file are C4-en validation documents (allenai/c4 revision 1588ec45): 2,097 byte-identical and 2 identical after Unicode NFC normalization; 1,021,899 tokens; its metadata names Paloma v3_small c4_en/val source files
in_loop_file_check.paloma_identity: unverified: allenai/paloma is gated and no Hugging Face credential is available on this machine; scripts/check_c4_eval_file.py compares by document id and text hash once Paloma's c4_en/val files are supplied
